goal: Close the loop on started work. Never silent-merge. Never fold one idea into another PR.

actions.finish: Review this exact PR. Merge it or close it. Do not dump its commits onto another branch.
actions.park: Leave extra drafts. No new agent on this repo.
actions.stop: Stale, empty, inventory, or duplicate of main — close with one sentence, or stop the agent.
actions.wait: Young draft. Do not nag. Do not squash into the finish pick.
actions.hard_gate: Secrets, draft, dirty merge, or missing audit. Do not merge.
